recognize_zh: 抹片中大量中型單核細胞成片或成群分布，細胞核圓、染色質細、細胞質淡藍，另有數團深色色素或碎屑；此視野看不到吞噬血球的組織球，無法單憑此圖確認噬血現象。
features: Numerous medium-sized mononuclear cells arranged singly and in loose aggregates
Round to slightly indented nuclei with fine to moderately condensed chromatin
Scant to moderate pale blue cytoplasm; some cells slightly larger with more cytoplasm
Several dark clumps of pigment or debris associated with cells
No convincing macrophage containing phagocytosed hematopoietic cells in this field
describe_en: Aspirate smear shows a cellular population dominated by medium-sized mononuclear cells with round nuclei, fine chromatin and pale blue cytoplasm, arranged singly and in loose aggregates. Several dark pigment or debris clumps are present, and occasional larger cells with more cytoplasm are seen. No definite hemophagocytic histiocytes are identified in this field. The image does not by itself demonstrate hemophagocytosis; the identity of the dominant population should be established with immunophenotyping and review of other fields.

ddx.vs: Blasts show nucleoli and fine chromatin with high N:C ratio and are confirmed by flow cytometry; a reactive population is heterogeneous.
A monotonous lymphoid population with clonal immunophenotype would favor lymphoma over a reactive process.
HLH requires macrophages containing engulfed red cells or nucleated cells, which are not demonstrated here.
